guarantees.claim: On asynchronous reset (rst_ni low), rand_data_q is loaded with the constant RndCnstBufferLfsrSeed.
On a rising clock edge when data_update or msg_mask_en_i is high, rand_data_q is updated with prng_data_permuted.
When neither reset nor update condition is true, rand_data_q retains its previous value.

assumptions.claim: When data_update or msg_mask_en_i is asserted at a rising clock edge, prng_data_permuted must provide a valid and stable random value.
assumptions.cond: update condition true at posedge clk_i
assumptions.risk: rand_data_q latches an X or stale value, corrupting entropy/masking.

uncertain_points.claim: rand_data_q holds sensitive entropy or masking material but has no clear/wipe path; a security event (fatal alert, key clear) could leave secret state intact.
uncertain_points.risk: Retained entropy/mask bits may be recoverable after a breach attempt, violating secret-wipe requirements.

uncertain_points.claim: The update condition data_update || msg_mask_en_i may be asserted before prng_data_permuted is stable, or both may toggle simultaneously, creating ambiguous update ordering.
uncertain_points.cond: when prng_data_permuted timing is unknown or when data_update and msg_mask_en_i overlap
uncertain_points.risk: rand_data_q could capture a transient or unintended value if the producer contract is violated.
